# Privacy Policy

Simple Image Downloader does not collect, store, sell, or share personal data. It does not sell personal data or browsing data.

The extension processes image URLs, dimensions, and browser-provided size metadata locally in Chrome, only after the user opens the extension popup on the active tab. This data is used only to show the image list and start the selected download.

The extension does not use analytics, advertising, tracking, accounts, external servers, or third-party services. Browsing activity and page content are not transmitted to the developer or to any external service by this extension.

Data is processed locally in the browser and is not retained by the extension after the popup is closed.
